item.title: Version 1.1.10
item.description:
Version 1.1.10 Release Notes

🎨 UI Polish, Smooth Hover Interactions & Widget Theme Fixes

  • Desktop-Class Grid Hovering: Instant cell highlight scaling with a smart 400ms dwell delay and live sticky tooltip session.
  • Activity Timeline Styling: Transparent card background in Light mode with subtle light grey border outline.
  • Dynamic Filter Metrics: PR & Issue cards dynamically update labels and counts based on Settings filters.
  • App Icon Alignment: Full macOS WidgetKit AppIcon support in Edit Widgets picker and GitHub README header.
  • September 1 Midnight Grid Fix: Automatically appends today's date empty cell across local midnight timezone gaps.
  • Widget Theme Sync: Fixed preferences cache persistence so widgets update colors instantly when switching themes.
  • Header Button Symbols: Added gear & clockwise arrow SF Symbols to Config and Refresh buttons.
  • Main Window Height: Adjusted window height to 710px for ideal proportion.

item.title: Version 1.1.9
item.description:
Version 1.1.9 Release Notes

🎨 UI Polish, Pure White Light Mode & Token Storage Persistence

  • Pure White Light Mode: Updated general app background in Light mode to pure white (`#FFFFFF`).
  • Dark Metric Cards Styling: Aligned all metric summary card backgrounds to dark `#1A1A1A` in Dark mode.
  • Token Persistence Self-Healing Sync: Fixed token reset/reversion issue by guaranteeing `TokenStorage` updates all 3 persistence layers atomically.
  • Settings Window Polish: Restored clean section dividers and solid titlebar header background.
  • Sparkle Build Alignment: Fully aligned build numbers (`1.1.9 (11)`) for instant zero-loop automatic updates.

item.title: Version 1.1.7
item.description:
Version 1.1.7 Release Notes

🐛 GraphQL Search Query & Metric Alignment Bug Fixes

  • GraphQL Variable Interpolation Fix: Resolved critical bug where open/assigned issue and PR counts returned 0 due to GraphQL query string literal formatting.
  • All-Time Issues & PRs Metrics: Added dedicated search queries for all-time created issues and PRs (e.g., 100 issues, 106 PRs) matching GitHub dashboard counts.
  • Review Requests & Involves Alignment: Fixed review request counts to track open requests (instead of submitted reviews) and updated "Involves me" PR filtering and label.
  • Service State Persistence: Fixed state reset bug in `ContributionService` that inadvertently cleared search metrics before saving to local cache.

item.title: Version 1.1.6
item.description:
Version 1.1.6 Release Notes

🛠️ Build System Packaging & Version Alignment Fix

  • XcodeGen Packaging Automation: Updated `package_release.sh` script to run `xcodegen generate` and pass `MARKETING_VERSION` (`1.1.6`) directly into `xcodebuild`.
  • App Bundle Version Verification: Guaranteed compiled `.app` inside `.dmg` and `.zip` reports exact Version 1.1.6 (Build 8), completely eliminating the repeating Sparkle update prompt.

item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description:
Version 1.1.5 Release Notes

🔑 Info.plist Dynamic Version & Sparkle Loop Fix

  • Dynamic Info.plist Versioning: Fixed hardcoded version string in Info.plist to dynamically resolve `MARKETING_VERSION` (`1.1.5`) and `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` (`7`).
  • Sparkle Update Loop Fix: Resolved issue where Sparkle continuously prompted for update due to version string mismatch. Now accurately reports up-to-date status.

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
Version 1.1.4 Release Notes

🎨 Settings UI Polish & Token Sync Fixes

  • Settings Window Polish: Restored solid native window background with crisp control cards and divider lines, removing washed-out transparency.
  • Token Sync Fix: Guaranteed automatic loading of saved Personal Access Token into Settings text field on view appear (`.onAppear`), ensuring smooth 5,000 req/hr API access without rate limit warnings.
  • Release Workflow Protection: Added release existence checks to GitHub Actions release workflow.

item.title: Version 1.1.3

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
Version 1.1.2 Release Notes

🔐 Token Persistence & Developer Documentation

  • Triple-Layer Self-Healing Credential Storage: GitHub tokens are now backed up across System Keychain, App Group storage, and persistent container files. Prevents token resetting/clearing across app updates and binary replacements.
  • Redesigned Developer README & Public Roadmap: Visual showcase grids, feature breakdowns, and a live development roadmap matrix.
  • CI/CD Build Stability: Updated GitHub Actions workflow with Xcode 16 compatibility.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Version 1.1.1 Release Notes

🐞 Bug Fixes & Auto-Update Improvements

  • Dynamic Version Display: Settings → About tab now dynamically displays your exact running GitStreak version string.
  • Sparkle Auto-Update Authorization: Resolved installer launch error by adjusting sandboxing privileges so in-app updates replace and restart GitStreak cleanly.
  • Up-To-Date Verification: Users on the latest release receive clear confirmation when checking for updates.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Version 1.1.0 Release Notes

🚀 New Features & Customization

  • Customizable Pull Requests Widget: Select what category to display on desktop (Created PRs, Assigned PRs, Mentioned PRs, or Review Requests).
  • Customizable Issues Widget: Select what Issue filter to display (All Opened Issues, Currently Open Issues, or Assigned Issues).
  • Pre-Selected GitHub Token Generator: 1-click token setup pre-fills app description and pre-selects required repo & read:user scopes on GitHub.
  • Vector Octicon Icons: Native vector rendering for GitHub Octicon git-commit SVG icon.
  • Medium Matrix Widget: Pure 17-column contribution grid widget without text overlay.

🔒 Security & Privacy

  • Keychain Encryption: All GitHub Personal Access Tokens and OAuth tokens are stored in macOS System Keychain.
  • Complete Data Wipe: "Sign Out" and "Reset & Clear All Data" completely purge stored Keychain tokens, local cache, and preferences.
  • No Password Prompts: Migrated to Data Protection Keychain (kSecUseDataProtectionKeychain) to eliminate legacy "login keychain password" prompt popups.

⚡ Performance & Fixes

  • Rate Limit Protection: Balanced background auto-refresh to 15 minutes and cache-first year switching, using less than 0.1% of daily GitHub quotas.
  • Sanitized Token Input: Automatic whitespace and newline trimming on token paste.
  • Thread Safety & Swift 6: Resolved background thread publishing warnings and satisfied Swift 6 exhaustive widget family matching.
